title: Global Account Manager - Home Automation

The Global Account Manager (GAM) will be responsible for driving strategic growth and executive engagement with a portfolio of global Home Automation customers. This role will own the development and execution of account strategies that expand design wins, increase revenue, and strengthen long-term partnerships across security, smart home, energy management, building automation, and connected device applications.

• Own the global account strategy for assigned Home Automation customers and drive execution across all regions.

• Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with customer decision makers, engineering leaders, product managers, sourcing teams, and business executives.

• Identify, develop, and close new design-win opportunities that drive long-term revenue growth.

• Coordinate worldwide resources across sales, field applications, business lines, marketing, and ecosystem partners.

• Lead account planning, opportunity management, and strategic business reviews.

• Influence customer technology roadmaps and align them with NXP product strategies.

• Drive demand creation activities including architecture discussions, reference design adoption, and platform selection.

• Serve as the executive escalation point for strategic customer issues.

• Deliver regular business updates to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or related field.

• 8+ years of semiconductor, technology, IoT, or related industry experience.

• 5+ years of experience managing strategic or global accounts.

• Demonstrated success growing revenue and winning complex technical sales opportunities.

• Experience engaging executive, engineering, and procurement stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of semiconductor sales cycles and demand creation methodologies.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to work across multiple functions and geographies.

• Strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities.

• Ability to travel globally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.

• Experience supporting Home Automation, Smart Home, Building Automation, Security, Access Control, Energy Management, or IoT customers.

• Knowledge of wireless technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Matter, Thread, Zigbee, UWB, and cellular IoT.

• Experience selling MCU, MPU, connectivity, security, software, or AI-enabled embedded solutions.

• Understanding of smart building and home automation market trends.
